verdict.rationale: OpenRouter documents per-request routing: an ordered `models` fallback list that switches models when providers are down, rate-limited or refuse to reply, plus a `provider` object for customizing provider routing and load balancing. Its docs say it picks the most cost-effective option per request, and community users confirm default fallbacks and an auto-routing 'meta' model that sends prompts to an appropriately capable model. Availability-based switching is strongly evidenced; cost and capability policies are thinner. Missing for 10: first-party docs for capability-based auto-routing, explicit cost-threshold routing rules, evidence of declarative gateway-level policy rules beyond per-request parameters, hands-on corroboration of mid-task switching in agent loops.
